changes.rationale: June 17 issuer release announces definitive Silevo acquisition and 10 a.m. ET transaction call. Contemporaneous account directly attributes the 17.58% session gain to the acquisition and manufacturing plans. Class 2 acquirer exception applies; agreement execution June 16 is distinct from June 17 public announcement.

Primary agreement is dated August 19, but August 22 contemporaneous account says Friday run-up was halted pending further news and describes sale details as Monday news. Revised 49% subsidiary disposal replaces an earlier full-business sale. Do not infer public timing from contract date or use Monday disclosure to explain Friday jump; session attribution and eligibility need resolution.

October 14 TripAdvisor/Priceline issuer release establishes an operational instant-booking partnership. The reviewed security is Liberty TripAdvisor rather than contracting TripAdvisor. Class 6 is plausible through controlled-company exposure, but direct attribution of LTRPA jump and consistent treatment of parent-level indirect catalysts remain unresolved. Do not label it a direct Liberty contract.

Same-day account explicitly includes CVR Energy in broad refining rally following election, attributed to hoped-for changes to RFS/RIN burdens. Expectations of future policy change are not an issued regulator decision or completed issuer-specific legal unlock. Existing Icahn ownership is not a newly announced activist campaign.

Historical ESI is ITT Educational Services. Primary December 4 financing agreement confirms $100 million secured term borrowing used for collateral and refinancing; contemporaneous December 5 business-news archive attributes share surge to loan agreement. Liquidity relief alone is financing rather than qualifying partnership or legal resolution. Earliest publication time is not independently certified.

Issuer archive states Q1 results were scheduled after May 13 market close, and primary release confirms results date. These results cannot automatically explain the May 13 close-to-close jump. Correct legacy earnings-session assumption; no supported earlier catalyst recovered in this targeted check. Later Goldman financing is also not same-session evidence.

Legacy June 13 8-K locator reports director changes on June 10, not June 6 clinical success. Later issuer results corroborate June IDMC continuation and related financing, while news archive dates recommendation June 13. None establishes June 6 successful readout. Targeted date/source search leaves jump attribution unresolved; do not backdate later news.

October 26 16:35 ET issuer release schedules first solid-tumor AG-120 results for November 8 plenary/press program. This supports next-session anticipation news, not newly reported successful clinical data. Conference selection and plans to present are not themselves a clinical readout, regulatory approval or technical breakthrough.

June 11 contemporaneous account reports Baker Bros 13G increase to a 14% holding. It supplies ownership disclosure, with no board challenge, sale process or control proposal. Large ownership alone does not qualify as class 11 activism; do not substitute later FDA milestones. Classification relies on reported filing type; original filing still needs recovery for complete provenance.

Contemporaneous sector account and Reuters market report describe oil-producer rally following OPEC production-cut agreement. Treat the documented broad commodity catalyst as outside issuer-specific keep classes; a coordinated oil-supply decision is not regulatory approval of SM product or issuer-specific legal unlock. Exhaustive competing-news search is not certified.

No exhaustive earlier-public search; no training or evaluation gates unlocked.
